tagline_or_one_liner: Sierra helps businesses build better, more human customer experiences with AI; it describes itself as a conversational AI platform for businesses.
business_model: B2B enterprise software/platform. Sierra sells conversational AI agents and related agent-building, orchestration, analytics, and governance capabilities to businesses. The site states that its pricing is outcome-based: customers pay for value/results delivered rather than tokens.

products_and_services.name: Sierra conversational AI platform
products_and_services.description: A platform for businesses to deploy AI agents that handle customer experiences and pursue business outcomes.
products_and_services.value_proposition: Unifies customer interactions and outcomes across channels, with built-in trust, security, compliance, and guardrails.

products_and_services.name: Ghostwriter
products_and_services.description: An agent-building agent that creates and optimizes production-ready customer-experience agents from prompts, SOPs, transcripts, audio interviews, or other business materials.
products_and_services.value_proposition: Lets customer-experience teams build, test, review, and continuously improve multilingual, multichannel agents without clicks, code, or complex manual debugging.

products_and_services.name: Agent Studio
products_and_services.description: A no-code environment for building and managing agents, configuring customer journeys and knowledge, defining brand guidelines, and running simulations.
products_and_services.value_proposition: Empowers customer-experience teams to manage agents without writing code.

products_and_services.name: Horizon
products_and_services.description: Long-horizon agents that act on signals, retain customer context, plan next steps, and orchestrate inbound and outbound interactions over days, weeks, or months.
products_and_services.value_proposition: Drives high-value outcomes through proactive, omnichannel engagement, persistent memory, next-best-action decisioning, and playbooks.

products_and_services.name: Insights
products_and_services.description: Analytics, experimentation, monitoring, auditing, and observability for evaluating and optimizing agent performance.
products_and_services.value_proposition: Helps businesses track metrics such as CSAT and resolution, investigate trends, identify conversations needing attention, run experiments, and understand agent actions.

products_and_services.name: Explorer
products_and_services.description: Natural-language analytics and conversation research that answers questions about customer conversations and recommends improvements.
products_and_services.value_proposition: Provides ChatGPT-style analysis and actionable recommendations from agent and customer-interaction data.

products_and_services.name: Multichannel agent deployment
products_and_services.description: A single agent can operate across chat, SMS, WhatsApp, email, voice, and ChatGPT.
products_and_services.value_proposition: Unifies channels and preserves context as customers switch between them.

products_and_services.name: Context Engine
products_and_services.description: Customer-context and memory capabilities used to connect conversations, systems, and touchpoints.
products_and_services.value_proposition: Enables personalized decisions and continuity across customer journeys.

who_they_sell_to: Customer experience and customer support organizations

geography.headquarters: Not explicitly identified on the crawled pages; the company says it is based in New York and names San Francisco as where it began.

scale_claims.claim: The customer page says Sierra is trusted by industry leaders with millions of customers.
The customer directory shows 50 customer stories/results entries.
Sierra says it has offices in New York, Atlanta, London, Singapore, Tokyo, Paris, Madrid, Toronto, and San Francisco.
Sierra says its agents can operate in multiple languages and across chat, SMS, WhatsApp, email, voice, and ChatGPT.

public_or_private: Not found on crawled pages; appears to be a private company based on the site's presentation, but this is not explicitly stated in the reviewed sources.

signals: Healthcare workflows involving patients, providers, payers, EHRs, prior authorization, scheduling, and clinical notes

support_or_contact_center_evidence.evidence: Sierra positions its platform around customer service, customer experience, support teams, contact centers, and customer interactions; customer stories include transforming support and inbound sales calls.
Ghostwriter is designed for customer-experience teams to build, test, and improve agents and support workflows.
Customer examples cite support-team augmentation, 24/7 availability, multilingual engagement, and contact-centre operations.
Customer stories include support, inbound sales calls, banking support, patient service, and utility customer service.

helpdesk_or_crm_mentions: Systems integrations are mentioned for Ghostwriter, but specific CRM/helpdesk products were not named on the crawled pages.
Horizon references EHRs, scheduling APIs, payer phone workflows, provider messaging, and calendar/scheduling systems.
The site describes integration with existing tools for alerts.

existing_ai_or_chatbot_mentions.evidence: The homepage presents Sierra Agent and calls Sierra the leading conversational AI platform for businesses.
Ghostwriter creates and optimizes AI agents, including automated simulations, edge-case testing, and fixes.
Horizon provides long-horizon AI agents for proactive and reactive customer engagement.

icp_evidence.site_evidence: Sierra says it works with industry leaders and customers with millions of customers; its customer directory includes major brands such as Rocket Mortgage, SiriusXM, Redfin, Ramp, and others.
The company explicitly targets customer-experience teams, support teams, contact centers, and customer-service journeys.

icp_evidence.icp_criterion: Complex, high-value workflows where outcomes matter
icp_evidence.site_evidence: Horizon describes mortgage, claims, renewal, healthcare referral, scheduling, prior authorization, and other long-horizon playbooks.

icp_evidence.icp_criterion: Need for omnichannel and multilingual engagement
icp_evidence.site_evidence: Sierra supports chat, SMS, WhatsApp, email, voice, and ChatGPT; the about page cites 24/7 and any-language customer engagement.

possible_disqualifiers_from_site.disqualifier: Organizations without substantial customer-experience volume or complex workflows may not fit the enterprise outcome-oriented platform.
possible_disqualifiers_from_site.site_evidence: Sierra emphasizes leading brands, millions of customers, measurable business impact at scale, and outcomes-based pricing.

possible_disqualifiers_from_site.disqualifier: Highly regulated or brand-sensitive deployments may require extensive security, compliance, guardrails, auditability, and human sign-off review.
possible_disqualifiers_from_site.site_evidence: The site emphasizes trust, security, compliance, goals, guardrails, auditing, consent, suppression, and human sign-off.

possible_disqualifiers_from_site.disqualifier: Organizations seeking a simple FAQ chatbot rather than broader agent orchestration and customer-outcome automation may be a poor fit.
possible_disqualifiers_from_site.site_evidence: Sierra positions its agents around multi-step outcomes, proactive engagement, long-horizon planning, system actions, and continuous optimization.
